# Third-party vendored crates

## `crypt4gh`

SynapticFour fork of [crypt4gh 0.4.1](https://crates.io/crates/crypt4gh), identical lineage to [Ferrum `third_party/crypt4gh`](https://github.com/SynapticFour/Ferrum/tree/main/third_party/crypt4gh).

Wired via root `[patch.crates-io]`. When Ferrum updates the fork, refresh this tree in a dedicated PR (note the Ferrum revision in the commit message).
